# Aptología — housing answers from open data

> Direct, data-backed answers (open data, CC BY 4.0, by Aptología, aptologia.com) on rents and sale prices of homes by neighbourhood and city in Colombia and 12 more countries. Listings active as of 18 October 2026; every answer cites n, date, source and the DOI (Zenodo) or GitHub folder of the original Spanish study. Author: Daniel Mauricio Pinzón Pineda (ORCID 0009-0007-5142-366X).
